decision.reason: The graphify semantic path reaches Occamy end-to-end and returns a parsed graph. Gate A extraction works on the real repo with zero worktree pollution. No ~150-line in-repo fallback is required on the evidence available; only Gate C (cosmetic labelling) is unverified, blocked by the shared Occamy endpoint going down mid-session.

gate_a.pollution_note: .worktrees/, node_modules/, .tmp-consonance/, .consonance/, scratch/, tmp/ are all honoured as ignored, so ZERO worktree pollution (verified from node source_file values, not from assumption). failure_diagnosis.timeline: 05:26 endpoint UP (HTTP 200, 0.114 s, reply 'ready'); 05:31 tiny semantic extraction SUCCEEDS (exit 0, 54 s); 05:36-05:43 real-docs runs fail with Connection error; 05:44 endpoint DOWN (connection refused). failure_diagnosis.request_shape: graphify's openai path was independently verified reachable BEFORE the outage: the identical tiny command succeeded at 05:31 and failed with the same 'Connection error' at 05:43, so the request shape is not the variable. graphify sends max_completion_tokens (llm.py:1409), stream=False, optional temperature/reasoning_effort and extra_body; llm.py:1417 already documents chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false for self-hosted Qwen3.

This is the same message seen during the real outage, confirming the outage (not the corpus) caused the failures.

next_unit_hint: Adopt graphify, no fallback needed. For the semantic pass always: (1) pre-flight the curl liveness probe, abort if it is not HTTP 200 - that alone would have saved this unit 20 minutes; (2) wrap graphify in `stdbuf -oL -eL`, or a timeout silently discards every progress line (graphify block-buffers stdout off-TTY); (3) do NOT use the 60000 default --token-budget - output runs ~2x input tokens (913 in -> 1938 out) at ~36 output tok/s, so budget 1500-2000 per chunk and run the corpus in bounded background jobs, resuming (the semantic cache is resumable per chunk); (4) read graph.json edges from the 'links' key and use 'built_at_commit' as the provenance stamp; (5) expect confidence='EXTRACTED' on EDGES with confidence_score, and node-level file_type in {document,concept,rationale} with source_location null for semantic nodes vs L<n> for code nodes - a confidence filter must read edges, not nodes; (6) treat .lane-j-scratch/ (23 nodes, untracked and not gitignored) as the only pollution; .worktrees/ and node_modules/ are correctly excluded; (7) `explain` and `query` both accept bare labels, so the query battery needs no id lookup step.
